## Compare Overmind to Competitors

F

Faddom

Faddom provides application dependency mapping and infrastructure visualization within the IT sector. The company has a tool for mapping on-premises and cloud environments, allowing users to see interdependencies and manage changes without needing agents or credentials. Faddom's solutions are applicable to sectors that require IT asset documentation, change management, migration planning, resource optimization, and compliance with network security and audit standards. It was founded in 2021 and is based in Ramat Gan, Israel.

C

ControlMonkey [...] C

ControlMonkey

ControlMonkey develops a cloud operations platform. The company offers services to enable DevOps leaders to manage cloud infrastructure proactively, initiating terraform to automate and govern cloud environments. It provides the tools and processes to amplify Infrastructure as Code (IaC) benefits to gain full governance on the cloud and prevent service interruptions, misconfigurations, and non-compliant resources. Its primary customers are within the cloud computing industry. It was founded in 2022 and is based in Tel Aviv, Israel.
